tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazdy z ponizszych dialogow (1.1-1.6), wybierajac odpowiedz A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: When shall we meet up?
Y: _________
options: A) I met up with them on Saturday afternoon.
B) How about on Saturday afternoon?

items.stem:
X: I was wondering if you'd like to come over for dinner on Friday.
Y: _________
options: A) That sounds lovely. What time shall I come round?
B) That sounds lovely. What time did you come round?
C) That sounds lovely. What time do I come round?

items.stem:
X: Something's come up and I can't make it tomorrow.
Y: _________
options: A) Never mind. Shall we put it on till next week?
B) Never mind. Shall we put it off till next week?
C) Never mind. Shall we put off it till next week?

items.stem:
X: Are you still coming to the concert on Saturday?
Y: _________
options: A) Actually, I've been thinking of dropping in.
B) Actually, I've been thinking of drop out.
C) Actually, I've been thinking of dropping out.

items.stem:
X: Let's go for a picnic if the weather's nice.
Y: _________
options: A) And what if it rains?
B) So what if it rains?
C) And what if it will rain?

items.stem:
X: I need to pick up the tickets before the show.
Y: _________
options: A) Don't worry. I'll have been picking them up by then.
B) Don't worry. I'll have picked them up by then.
C) Don't worry. I'll have picked up them by then.
